newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Monday, said a New York Fed spokeswoman.
The Fed's operation was expected, given analysts' predictions of a $9 billion average daily add need until the two-week reserve period ends on Wednesday.
Fed funds were trading at 5-5/8 percent when the Fed entered the open market, above the 5-1/4 percent Fed target.
